name: alert-dialog

<script lang="ts">
	import { setCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	import type { CompCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	let { open = $bindable(false), onOpenChange, size = "md", rounded = "2xl", children }: Props = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	const contextData: Pick<CompCtxProps, "size" | "rounded" | "onOpenChange"> = $derived({ size, rounded, onOpenChange });
	const ctx = setCompCtx({ ...contextData, open, baseId });

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(ctx, contextData));

	// Keep the bindable prop and the shared open state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.open = open));
	$effect.pre(() => void (open = ctx.open));
</script>

<!-- Trigger and content parts; the content renders the modal while open. -->
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ActionProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, size, onclick, ...props }: ActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Buttons stay at `md` in the large panel, and follow the panel size below it.
	const buttonSize = $derived(size ?? (ctx.size === "lg" ? "md" : ctx.size));

	/** Runs the passed handler, then closes the alert dialog unless the handler prevented the default. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		// If the passed handler called preventDefault: keep the dialog open, such as while a request runs.
		if (e.defaultPrevented) return;
		ctx.setOpen(false);
	};
</script>

<!-- Confirms the action and closes the alert dialog. -->
<Button type="button" size={buttonSize} {...props} onclick={handleClick}>
	{@render children()}
</Button>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { CancelProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, variant = "outline", size, onclick, ...props }: CancelProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Buttons stay at `md` in the large panel, and follow the panel size below it.
	const buttonSize = $derived(size ?? (ctx.size === "lg" ? "md" : ctx.size));

	/** Runs the passed handler, then closes the alert dialog. */
	const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
		onclick?.(e);
		ctx.setOpen(false);
	};
</script>

<!-- Dismisses the alert dialog; focused when it opens. -->
<Button type="button" {variant} size={buttonSize} data-alert-dialog-cancel {...props} onclick={handleClick}>
	{@render children()}
</Button>

{#if ctx.open}
{@render children()}
{/if}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { FooterProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: FooterProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
</script>

<!-- Action buttons; stacked with the action on top on narrow screens. -->
<footer class={["alertDialogFooter", className]} data-size={ctx.size} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</footer>

<style>
	/* Base footer; reversed so the action, written last, sits on top */
	.alertDialogFooter {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column-reverse;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
	}

	/* A row aligned to the end once the panel is wide enough */
	@media (min-width: 40rem) {
		.alertDialogFooter {
			flex-direction: row;
			justify-content: flex-end;
		}
	}

	/* =============== Sizes =============== */

	/* Extra small */
	.alertDialogFooter[data-size="xs"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-xs);
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { HeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeaderProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
</script>

<!-- Title and description; centered on narrow screens. -->
<header class={["alertDialogHeader", className]} data-size={ctx.size} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</header>

<style>
	/* Base header */
	.alertDialogHeader {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		text-align: center;
	}

	/* Aligns to the start once the panel is wide enough */
	@media (min-width: 40rem) {
		.alertDialogHeader {
			text-align: left;
		}
	}

	/* =============== Sizes =============== */

	/* Extra small */
	.alertDialogHeader[data-size="xs"] {
		gap: var(--spacing-xs);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "outline", size, rounded, class: className }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps = { "aria-haspopup": "dialog" as const, onclick: () => ctx.setOpen(true) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise a default button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}

description: A modal that interrupts the user to confirm an important action, built on the native dialog element.
